answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the pearl of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the inlet of a task receipt, and the ocean is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
